$comment: Turkish housing loan rules. Pinned rather than looked up at runtime, and every rule carries where it came from and when it was captured — the same discipline as recording the first print of a series. Most tables on the open web still show the 2023 decision and are wrong.

loan_to_value.note: Ratio of loan to the value of the housing taken as collateral. The 29.01.2026 decision removed the new/second-hand distinction; the ratio now depends only on value and energy class.

energy_classes.A_B: A or B on the Enerji Kimlik Belgesi (Law 5627)

source.regulation: Bankaların Kredi İşlemlerine İlişkin Yönetmelik, madde 12
source.note: Taken from secondary sources and NOT yet read in the regulation itself. Treated as provisional until it is.

taxes.note: Housing finance loans are exempt from both. This is the difference from a consumer loan and it changes the payment materially, so it is recorded as a rule rather than left as an assumption in code.
